name: Heart of Iron

pages.text: After defeating a Magnetron, recover its fallen heart; it crafts a shield and quarry.

pages.title: Source
pages.text: Find a Magnetron in the Magnetic Caves. When it detects an enemy, it assembles a body from surrounding blocks. After defeat that body breaks apart and the heart falls as a separate block: inspect the site, not only loose item drops.

pages.title: Use
pages.text: The heart crafts the Magnetic Quarry and Resistor Shield. JEI shows their materials and layouts. Placing the heart into an arbitrary machine does not assemble a quarry; it needs its recipe and then correctly placed Magnetic Lights.
